description: NaFeF₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.76 Å. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-42°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms.
